label: customer charged twice for one order
text: Two identical charges appear on a customer's card for a single checkout. Our handler ran twice; the provider says it delivered once.
target: Payment webhook delivered more than once

label: messages reprocessed after a deploy
text: Every time we roll out, a batch of events gets handled a second time and downstream state goes wrong. Consumers restart at the same moment.
target: Consumer group rebalance loses in-flight messages

label: database refuses new connections under load
text: During a spike everything starts timing out waiting to acquire a connection. Increasing the pool size just moves the problem.
target: Connection pool exhausted during a retry storm

label: some hosts reject a token others accept
text: The same bearer token is rejected on one replica and accepted on another. The token has not expired according to our own clock.
target: Token validation fails intermittently from clock drift

label: service never recovers after an outage
text: When the dependency comes back up, every client retries at exactly the same instant and knocks it over again immediately.
target: Retries synchronize and hammer the recovering service

label: spike of identical expensive queries
text: When one popular entry falls out of the cache, hundreds of requests all recompute it at once and the backend saturates.
target: Cache stampede when a hot key expires

label: intermittent connection reset from upstream
text: Clients see resets on reused connections. The proxy in front of us closes idle sockets sooner than the client expects to.
target: Load balancer idle timeout shorter than keep-alive

label: requests fail during rollout
text: A small number of requests error out whenever a pod is replaced. Work in progress is cut off rather than finished.
target: SIGTERM kills requests still in flight

label: whole service marked down when one dependency is slow
text: Our health endpoint calls the database, so when the database is degraded the orchestrator pulls every instance out at once.
target: Readiness probe wired to a dependency check

label: invoice totals off by a cent
text: Summing line items gives a total that does not match what we billed. The difference is fractions of a cent that accumulate.
target: Floating point used for money

label: list grows between unrelated calls
text: A function that should start with an empty collection keeps values from the previous invocation.
target: Mutable default argument shared across calls

label: scheduled jobs run twice or not at all one night a year
text: Around the clock change, a recurring job either fires twice or is skipped, depending on the user's region.
target: Timezone arithmetic breaks across a DST boundary

label: one endpoint issues hundreds of queries
text: Rendering a list page makes one query for the list and then another query per row. Latency scales with page size.
target: N+1 queries from lazy ORM relationship access

label: join is fast in dev and slow in prod
text: A lookup by a referencing column does a sequential scan. The referenced side is indexed; the referencing side is not.
target: Missing index on a foreign key column

label: deploy aborts on a schema change
text: The migration fails immediately on the production table but succeeds on an empty local one. Existing rows have no value for the new column.
target: ADD COLUMN NOT NULL fails on a populated table

label: site freezes for minutes during a release
text: A schema change takes an exclusive lock and every query queues behind it until it finishes rewriting the table.
target: Schema migration locks a table during deploy

label: process killed fetching a report
text: An endpoint with no limit pulls the entire table into memory when a customer's dataset grows large enough.
target: Unbounded result set loaded into memory

label: records missing or duplicated while paging
text: Paging through a changing list, some rows appear on two pages and others are never returned at all.
target: Offset pagination skips or repeats rows

label: one user's edit silently overwrites another's
text: Two people save the same record seconds apart. The second save is written on top of a value read before the first one landed.
target: Read-modify-write loses a concurrent update

label: duplicate row despite an existence check
text: We check whether the record exists and insert if it does not, but under load two requests both pass the check.
target: Non-atomic check-then-insert races under concurrency

label: usage count is lower than reality
text: A tally read, incremented and written back drifts down over time when many requests update it at once.
target: Counter increments lost under concurrent updates

label: client retry creates a second record
text: The write committed but the response was lost, so the client retried and the effect was applied a second time.
target: Retry after a committed write duplicates the effect

label: every build reinstalls all dependencies
text: Builds take the full time even when only one source file changed, because the source is added before the dependency step.
target: Docker layer cache invalidated by copying source too early

label: credential recoverable from a published image
text: A token was added and then deleted in a later step, but it is still readable in the image history.
target: Secrets baked into an image layer

label: process in the container has more privilege than it needs
text: Nothing drops privileges, so the workload runs with uid 0 and a container escape becomes a host compromise.
target: Container runs as root by default

label: build broke with no code change
text: A transitive dependency published a new release overnight and our specification allowed anything at or above a floor.
target: Dependency floor pin resolves to an unexpected version

label: install fails only on the oldest supported interpreter
text: One job in the matrix cannot resolve a package because the newest release requires a newer language runtime.
target: New library version silently drops an old runtime

label: config value becomes a boolean unexpectedly
text: An unquoted two-letter code in a configuration file is read as false instead of the string we wrote.
target: YAML parses unquoted country code NO as false

label: times shift by hours after a server move
text: Stored instants have no offset recorded, so they are interpreted in whatever zone the reading process happens to use.
target: Timestamps stored without timezone information

label: an attacker can learn a secret by measuring latency
text: Comparison of a supplied credential returns as soon as it differs, so response time leaks how much of the prefix was right.
target: String comparison used for authentication secrets

label: credentials cracked quickly after a dump
text: Stored credentials were digested with a fast algorithm, so an attacker with the dump can test billions of guesses.
target: Password hashed with a fast general-purpose hash

label: unexpected rows returned from a search box
text: A parameter is concatenated straight into the statement text, so a crafted value changes the meaning of the statement.
target: User input interpolated into a query string

label: file read from outside the upload directory
text: A supplied name containing traversal segments resolves above the directory we intended to confine reads to.
target: Path built from user input escapes the intended directory

label: one large upload exhausts memory
text: The handler reads the entire payload before checking its size, so a single client can push the process out of memory.
target: Unbounded request body read into memory

label: log file contains forged entries
text: A value from the request is written into the log verbatim, so newlines in it create entries that look like ours.
target: Client-supplied value logged without sanitization

label: stack trace returned to the caller
text: A failure response includes internal paths and query text, which tells an attacker about our structure.
target: Error message discloses internal detail

label: throttling stops working after scaling out
text: Each instance counts requests on its own, so the effective limit multiplies by the number of instances.
target: Rate limiter state held per process

label: monitoring backend runs out of memory
text: A per-request identifier was attached to a metric as a label, creating a new series for every request.
target: High-cardinality label on a metric

label: browser blocked by cross-origin policy intermittently
text: A cached response carries the allowed origin of a different caller, so the check fails for whoever gets the cached copy.
target: CORS preflight response cached with the wrong origin

label: sporadic auth failures when many workers start
text: Several workers notice the credential is near expiry at once and each exchanges it, invalidating the others.
target: Concurrent token refresh causes intermittent 401s

label: traffic keeps going to a decommissioned address
text: Pooled connections were established once and never re-resolved, so a record change does not take effect.
target: Long-lived connections pin to stale DNS records

label: two accounts that look identical are treated as different
text: Visually identical strings compare unequal because they use different code point sequences for the same characters.
target: Unicode normalization difference defeats an identity check

label: stored text ends in a replacement character
text: A field limited by bytes cuts a character in half when the input is not plain ASCII.
target: Byte-length limit truncates a multi-byte character

label: sorted list differs between two screens
text: The same set of names is ordered one way by the query and another way after the application sorts it.
target: Sort order differs between database and application

label: batch job instances pile up
text: A periodic task sometimes takes longer than its interval, so a second copy starts while the first is still running.
target: Cron job overruns and overlaps its next run

label: host out of space with no obvious large file
text: Output accumulated indefinitely with no rotation until writes started failing across every service on the box.
target: Disk fills with unrotated logs

label: deadline not propagated across service hops
text: The caller gives up after two seconds but the downstream service keeps working for thirty, wasting capacity on abandoned work.

label: search cluster degrades as fields multiply
text: Dynamic mapping created a new field for every key in a user-supplied document and the index metadata grew without bound.

label: connections dropped before the application sees them
text: The accept queue overflows during bursts and the kernel discards handshakes without the process ever knowing.

label: infrastructure state lock never released
text: A provisioning run was interrupted and left the shared state locked, so every later run refuses to start.

label: wrong process terminated under memory pressure
text: The kernel chose to kill the largest resident process rather than the one that was actually leaking.

label: writes rejected once the cache is full
text: The key-value store was configured never to evict, so once it reached its memory limit every write returned an error.

label: users served another user's page from the edge
text: The cache key omitted a parameter that changes the response, so one variant was served for all of them.

label: async service stops responding under moderate load
text: A blocking call inside an event loop occupies the worker, so concurrency collapses to the number of workers.

label: one request pegs a core for minutes
text: A pattern with nested quantifiers takes exponential time on an input that almost matches.

label: date handling breaks once every four years
text: Adding a year to the twenty-ninth of February produces an invalid date and the calculation throws.

label: memory grows steadily until restart
text: An in-process map used as a cache has no eviction and no bound, so it retains every key ever seen.

label: archive extraction overwrites files outside the target
text: Entries in the archive were followed as links and writes landed outside the extraction directory.

label: exported spreadsheet executes a formula
text: A field beginning with an equals sign is interpreted as a formula by the spreadsheet application that opens the export.

label: session identifier survives privilege change
text: The identifier issued before sign-in is kept afterwards, so anyone who knew it beforehand holds an authenticated session.

label: document parser reaches an internal host
text: The parser resolved an external entity declaration and fetched a URL from inside the network.

label: shared download link still works months later
text: The generated link was issued with a very long validity, so revoking access to the account does not revoke the link.

label: read immediately after a write returns the old value
text: The read was served by a follower that had not yet applied the change, so the caller saw stale data.

label: one system updated and the other did not
text: Two stores were written in the same logical operation and the second write failed after the first had already committed.

label: behaviour differs between staging and production
text: A toggle absent from the configuration falls back to a different default in each environment.

label: certificate expired without warning
text: Renewal was manual and the reminder went to someone who had left, so the service started failing handshakes.

label: queue grows without bound during a slowdown
text: Producers kept accepting work while consumers fell behind, and nothing applied backpressure to the source.

label: restore from backup produced an unusable database
text: Backups had been running for months but nobody had ever tried restoring one, and the procedure was missing a step.
